rooms.name: The Office
rooms.description: The office is half-decorated for tomorrow's celebration. Three award stations wait down the hall, each earned in turn. A note reads: "Earn all three trophies to light the rooftop."
rooms.unlock_text: Starting room — the celebration begins here.

rooms.name: Peer Unicorn Station
rooms.description: The teamwork station. Wires dangle, waiting to connect Malaysia's states to their capitals. Peer Unicorn is all about connection.
rooms.unlock_text: The Peer Unicorn station lights up.

rooms.name: Super Achiever Station
rooms.description: The station for those who reach the top. A keypad glows beneath a poster of Malaysia's most famous towers.
rooms.unlock_text: Peer Unicorn earned — the Super Achiever station opens.

rooms.name: Beyond Boundaries Station
rooms.description: The station for those who go further than anyone thought possible — even beyond Earth itself.
rooms.unlock_text: Super Achiever earned — the Beyond Boundaries station opens.

rooms.name: Rooftop Finale
rooms.description: The rooftop, strung with lights and a Jalur Gemilang snapping in the night breeze. Three trophies in hand. One last question stands between you and the fireworks.
rooms.unlock_text: All three trophies earned. The rooftop door swings open.
